data.narrative:
Noveon Magnetics is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by Scott Dunn and Peter Afiuny, having raised $365M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private robotics and manufacturing firms at Series B–D stages, plus 1 public company peer (277810.KQ). The private peer set includes Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), and Hadrian ($1.6B, Series D), among others.

Two methods triangulate the valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $365M total raised proxy, implying $620M. Peer-median analysis across the 7 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B. These methods diverge materially, reflecting uncertainty in both the appropriate multiple for Series C progression and the heterogeneity of peer-stage composition.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $527M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median point of $1.1B. Key uncertainties include the stage distribution of peers relative to Noveon's Series C inflection point and whether the 1.7x multiplier appropriately reflects current capital availability and sector dynamics. The wide range reflects this methodological tension and warrants further due diligence on revenue traction and market positioning.
